lines: A clean stitch still leaves a seam. I accept the stitch. I remember the cut.
Hard things can soften with work. Start there.
Trust is not leather, but it still stretches thin when treated badly.
Fine. Let us see whether your next touch is gentler.
You made a tear. The apology is a needle, not the whole repair.
I'll accept the first stitch. Keep sewing.
Rough handling leaves marks. I heard you admit that.
Don't pull at a mending place before it has strength.
I was wrong. I would rather say it plainly than dress it up.
That came out sharper than it should have. I am sorry.
